Dhoyī
or Dhoyīka; had the titles Kavirāja, Śrutidhara an. Śrutadhara; one of the five gems of the court of King Lakṣmaṇasena of Bengal (12th Cent.). Mentioned by Jayadeva in Gītagovinda. Q. many times in Skm. of which two verses are from his Pavanadūta, Śp. 1161.
See

(1873) p. 42. no. 96.
--Pavanadūta. kāvya.
Ed.. Chintaharan Chakravarthy. Sam3s. Sāh. Pariṣat

(1926).
For a collection of his verses found in the anthologies an. not found in Pavanadūta see intro. p.. 27-32 to the above edn. an.

, p.. 157ff.
Refers to his having written some other works in verse 104 of his work.
